name: joey-passion-recomp
description: Native macOS, Windows, Android and PS Vita port of Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Joey the Passion via static x86-to-C recompilation (bring your own game files)
long_description: A native port of **Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Joey the Passion** (Konami, PC 2004) to **macOS, Windows, Android and PS Vita**, made by **static recompilation**. The original Win32 x86 executable (`Joey_Pc.exe`) is translated to C, compiled natively for each platform and run on a small reimplementation of the parts of Windows and DirectX the game uses.
